action_summary: Keep the five-fold 448-pixel inference pipeline and add equally weighted original/horizontal-flip probability TTA. Disable rank conversion, supported by the latest paired leaderboard comparisons, instead of continuing rank-toggle experiments. Select the existing single-head or multi-head architecture from checkpoint keys with strict weight loading; preserve the supplied Kaggle weight paths and avoid inventing unavailable ensemble members. Cache both test views for each fold with IDs and class order, use numeric RGB normalization constants, and validate submission shape, identity order, finiteness, and probability range. The optional rank branch now handles ties and produces bounded values. No training or inference was run; improvement requires evaluation on competition data.
